_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); semiconductor signals with NVIDIA's rule-T thresholds; the listing rule (NVDA listed 1999-01-22)

pit_profile.why: 'NVIDIA is the world leader in visual computing. It enables us to open up new avenues of exploration, facilitate creativity and discovery, and power breakthroughs in new areas like artificial intelligence, virtual reality and autonomous cars.' 'The market for our products is intensely competitive and is characterized by rapid technological change, evolving industry standards and declining average selling prices.' Its current competitors include 'suppliers of discrete and integrated GPUs, including supercomputers and chipsets that incorporate 3D graphics functionality as part of their existing solutions, such as Advanced Micro Devices, or AMD, and Intel Corporation, or Intel' (FY2016 10-K); CYCLICAL kept although the 10-K no longer calls the business cyclical (the BKR FY2015 rule; the class label only); the 10-K names artificial intelligence and autonomous cars as markets NVIDIA serves, not as substitutes for its products, so no theme in taxonomy_eras.json applies (the FY2013 10-K's cloud reading), and GPUs integrated into other processors stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

BEAR.desc: EPS -17.8%/yr (worst year FY07-FY16 ex-FY09 ex-FY10, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +29.1%/yr (Q3 FY17 guide YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY09 ex-FY10 median

BULL.desc: EPS +29.1%/yr (FY07-FY16 ex-FY09 ex-FY10 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +44.7%/yr (best 2-yr run FY07-FY16 ex-FY09 ex-FY10, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: NVDA (retrospective, 2016-09-02) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (82.8% downside to Bear $10.73 / -24.3% upside to Bull $47.34) | Adj composite 2.60 vs market 3.75: gap -1.15 [OVERVALUED] | +286% above the EPP floor $16.20 (15x FY17E $1.08) | Conservative 2-yr case: -45.5% total (-22.7%/yr) | At 57.9x FY17E the 15% hurdle price $82.70 sits above the BULL case; revenue +23.9% YoY in Q2 FY17, forward revenues +26.2-31.3% (Q3 FY17 revenue guide (Q2 FY17 release)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
